value.description:
Wayfair believes everyone should live in a home they love. Through technology and innovation, we make it possible for shoppers to quickly and easily find exactly what they want from a selection of more than 14 million items across home furnishings, décor, home improvement, housewares, and more. Partnering with Product, Experience Design, Analytics, and business leaders across Wayfair, our Native App Engineering teams contribute to an award-winning mobile experience that makes shopping for your home delightful and engaging. iOS and Android engineers leverage the full capabilities of mobile devices and their SDKs. For example, our apps take advantage of augmented reality, computer vision-assisted product search using the device’s camera, and machine learning to create personalized experiences and improve the speed of the app.

The App Shop team charter is to empower customers across the entire shopping journey to explore detailed information on the products that support their feeling of home. The ideal candidate has experience in native Android development, and a proven track record of delivering high quality features efficiently. This person will leverage their breadth of knowledge to deliver features for Wayfair shoppers to make their shopping experience frictionless and delightful.

What You'll Do

Contribute to in-depth mobile projects surrounding middle-funnel functionality such as browsing and exploring product details, including architecting and developing new features, application maintenance and refactoring, and increased performance and automation.

Review code and provide guidance for other developers participating in our release approval process.

Being passionate about test coverage and quality engineering are paramount.

Use data and metrics to collaboratively drive impactful changes.

Frequently interface and interact with quality, UX, back-end/API, product, analytics, and other teams.

Though primarily focused on Android, collaborate with iOS and full-stack teams to ensure solutions are robust and aligned.

Lead by example; share knowledge, experience, and best practices through mentoring, tech talks, and presentations.

What You'll Bring

At least 1+ years of professional Android development on publicly available apps.

A passion for writing clean, readable, and thoroughly tested code, and an eagerness to share your expertise with others.

A mastery of Android fundamentals, interacting with endpoints, debugging, and memory management.

Experience having architected or designed complex features with product managers or other stakeholders.

A deep understanding of architecture patterns such as MVI, MVP, MVVM, Clean/VIPER, etc., as well as async patterns.

A drive to learn about new libraries and technologies, stay on the cutting edge of the evolving mobile landscape and an eagerness to create experiences that will delight users.

A genuine belief that constructive and respectful code reviews are the bedrock of a healthy team.

Knowledge of Material Design, Android UI/UX development, and best practices

Experience with the following is nice to have:

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and GraphQL

Ruby or similar scripting languages

Working cross-platform with iOS and/or Full-Stack

Assistance for Individuals with Disabilities
Wayfair is fully committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, including individuals with disabilities. As part of this commitment, Wayfair will make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of qualified individuals with disabilities, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on business operations. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please let us know by completing our Accomodations for Applicants form.

Need Technical Assistance?
For more information about applying for a career at wayfair, visit our FAQ page here.

About Wayfair Inc.
Wayfair is one of the world’s largest online destinations for the home. Whether you work in our global headquarters in Boston, or in our warehouses or offices throughout the world, we’re reinventing the way people shop for their homes. Through our commitment to industry-leading technology and creative problem-solving, we are confident that Wayfair will be home to the most rewarding work of your career. If you’re looking for rapid growth, constant learning, and dynamic challenges, then you’ll find that amazing career opportunities are knocking.

No matter who you are, Wayfair is a place you can call home. We’re a community of innovators, risk-takers, and trailblazers who celebrate our differences, and know that our unique perspectives make us stronger, smarter, and well-positioned for success. We value and rely on the collective voices of our employees, customers, community, and suppliers to help guide us as we build a better Wayfair – and world – for all. Every voice, every perspective matters. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice (https://www.wayfair.com/careers/privacy). If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at dataprotectionofficer@wayfair.com.

post.description:
Collect every review of a Wayfair product (loop on next_cursor until it is null) or keep a copy current: poll with sort=newest and stop at the last review_id or date you already hold. Use the product SKU (W110562316) or a wayfair.com /pdp/ product URL.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Send it with the same product, sort and ratings.

page_size.description:
Reviews per call. The upstream accepted 2000; 500 keeps responses small.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

product.description: Product SKU (e.g. W110562316) or a wayfair.com /pdp/ product URL; the SKU is the code at the end of the URL slug.

ratings.description: Only reviews with these star ratings (1-5). Default: all.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Stops paging at the first review dated earlier (inclusive of this date), so a sync that stores its newest date never re-reads old pages. Requires sort=newest. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sort.description:
newest is date descending (use it for incremental sync); relevance is Wayfair's default ordering; rating_high / rating_low order by stars; helpful orders by the site's helpfulness ranking.

Provider reference: allowed values ["newest", "relevance", "rating_high", "rating_low", "helpful"]; default "newest".

200.description:
Customer reviews for one Wayfair product, read from the storefront's own federation GraphQL endpoint (the same persisted query the product page's reviews widget uses). Pages to the last review with an opaque cursor (`next_cursor`, up to 500 reviews per call) and never needs a login. Sorts: newest, relevance, rating_high, rating_low, helpful. Optionally filter by star rating, and pass `since` with sort=newest to stop at a known date for incremental sync. Each review has its stable review_id, rating, text, display name, ISO date, verified flag, badge, purchased options and photo ids; the response carries the product's total review count, average rating and 1-5 star distribution. Wayfair exposes no review title and no helpful-vote counts, so neither is returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `average_rating` | number | Average star rating; null when the product has no reviews. |
| `count` | number | Reviews on this page. |
| `next_cursor` | string | Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page (or once `since` is reached). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `product` | object |  |
| `rating_distribution` | object[] | Review count per star rating for the whole product (one entry per star level the source lists). |
| `ratings` | number[] | Star filter as applied; empty means all. |
| `reviews` | object[] |  |
| `since` | string |  |
| `sort` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Reviews matching the request as the source counts them: every review of the product, or only those with the requested `ratings` when a star filter is set. |

200.description:
Search Wayfair's open jobs by title keywords and by team, team category, country, state, location and job type ids (ids from list_filters). The upstream POST returns every match at once; this function pages it locally (`page`, `page_size`) and reports the total. Each job carries its ids (job_id `{system}-{eid}`, eid, internal id), title, team, category, location, job type, level, salary range and currency as stated, posting dates, the brief description (HTML and text) and the detail and apply URLs, plus facet counts for the whole match set.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Jobs on this page. |
| `facets` | object | Counts per team, category, country, state, location and job type id over the whole match set. When nothing matches, Wayfair answers corpus-wide counts (probe of 2026-09-27); jobs without a US state are not counted under any state id. |
| `filters` | object |  |
| `jobs` | object[] |  |
| `keywords` | string | Keywords as sent (trimmed). |
| `next_page` | number | Page to request next; null when this page is the last. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `total` | number | Jobs matching upstream (the whole match set, before local paging). |
| `url` | string | The careers listing page with the same filters in its query string. |
